purpose: City-specific registry and public parcel-geometry source review. No owner, address, tax, or private property fields were requested or retained.
assessment: Rajasthan Urban GIS exposes Khasra/plot and village-boundary layers with district/tehsil/village/plot selectors and says the information is for viewing, not legal use. Rajasthan BhuNaksha is also a public cadastral viewer. Alwar GIS DLC pages show registration-office coverage but require login. No field-limited anonymous geometry query was verified, and no identifier-based record lookup was performed. No geometry feature was retained; geometry evidence remains unverified.
